abstract: Project-aware GitHub Copilot hook scaffolder that verifies the live official GitHub Copilot hook docs, audits a target repository in detail, and then generates a deterministic bash-first .github/hooks/copilot-hooks.json scaffold with one managed script per documented hook event, correct Copilot output-decision semantics, repeatable merges, reusable repo-owned script delegation, and a generated hooks README for the target project.
